[[Kappa]] have been eating [[Farmer Zinhao]]'s crops. He asks you to retrieve a [[Kappa Trap|kappa trap]] from [[Suhkaro]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
* Travel to [[Shing Jea Monastery]] and get a kappa trap for Farmer Zinhao.
* See Farmer Zinhao for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 75 [[Gold]]
* [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
Map travel to Shing Jea Monastery and talk to Suhkaro. Return to Farmer Zinhao in [[Panjiang Peninsula]] for your reward. He may not be present, if you have already got an active quest in the area.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Farmer Zinhao
:''"You look like the sort of person who gets around, if you do not mind my saying. Do you think you could do me a favor? Those accursed kappa have been eating my crops and I cannot get rid of them with just a pitchfork. It is too dangerous by far. But there is a hunter, name of Suhkaro, visiting Shing Jea Monastery if I'm not mistaken. '''Suhkaro''' promised me a Kappa Trap when last he passed through here, but he has not been back this way yet. If I do not get rid of the kappa, my crops will not survive until harvest!

:''If I promise to reward you for your time, would you pick up that '''kappa trap''' for me?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = Oh, why not? I've nothing better to do.
| decline = How does a lazy fellow like you even get crops planted in the first place?"''
| ask = Got the '''kappa trap''' from '''Suhkaro''' in Shing Jea Monastery.
}}

===Intermediate dialogue===
;Suhkaro
:''"A kappa trap for Farmer Zinhao? Yes, I have one ready. You might also offer him a word of warning...do not place any appendages in the trap if he wishes to keep them."''
If your [[inventory]] is full:
;Suhkaro
:''"A kappa trap for Farmer Zinhao? Yes, I have one ready. You might also offer him a word of warning...do not place any appendages in the trap if he wishes to keep them. Your inventory is full. Please make room and speak to me again."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Farmer Zinhao
:''"It looks a little rusty, but it should do the trick! Thank you, my friend. Thank you. And now...to trap me some kappa!"''
